card.name: Digits in a split-up percentage list
card.fires_on: The first or second digit of a two-digit percentage that comes late in a list of percentages summing to about 100, often right after 'and'. Common in adverse-event grades and outcome breakdowns.

modes.label: Last share of a breakdown
modes.description: A leading digit of the final or remaining percentage in a list of grades or outcomes.

modes.label: Complement of an earlier figure
modes.description: A digit of a percentage that makes up the rest after a stated share, such as resolved versus not resolved.

card.writes: It suppresses other digit tokens, so it shapes which digit comes next inside a number.
card.plain: It fires on the digits of a percentage near the end of a list of shares that add up to the whole.
